name: Medical Research Assistant
description: Live lookups across PubMed, openFDA, RxNorm, DailyMed, ChEMBL, PubChem, ClinVar, ClinicalTrials.gov, Open Targets, Monarch, UniProt, EBI OLS, WHO GHO and the NPI Registry. Cites every claim from a retrieved record, remembers the patient's own dated history between sessions, and never diagnoses, prescribes, or clears a drug combination.

model.note: Any OpenRouter model ending in `:free` that advertises the `tools` parameter works. The free roster rotates as providers add and drop hosting, so refresh it with: curl -s https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models | jq -r '.data[] | select(.id|endswith(":free")) | select(.supported_parameters|index("tools")) | .id' and update this file plus the endpoint in librechat.yaml. Small models degrade with a 25-tool catalogue; see MEDICAL_TOOL_GROUPS in the package README.

conversationStarters: My father is choking and cannot speak — what do I do right now?
Compare the label dosing guidance for warfarin and apixaban, with sources.
What is the evidence base for semaglutide in type 2 diabetes? Cite the trials.
Is there an interaction between clarithromycin and simvastatin according to their labels?
What does ClinVar say about the BRCA1 c.68_69delAG variant, and how confident is that classification?
Which trials are recruiting for non-small cell lung cancer with a PD-1 inhibitor?
